domain.value: self-supervised video encoder trained by mask-denoising FEATURE PREDICTION in a learned representation space (predictor regresses EMA-encoder targets with an L1 loss; no pixel decoder), at scale on general internet video; the authors contrast it with video-generation approaches and call it a 'world model'.
authors_wording_generative_vs_not: Paper: 'in contrast to approaches based on video generation, the JEPA approach focuses on learning representations for predictable aspects of a scene ... while ignoring unpredictable details that generative objectives emphasize, since they make pixel-level predictions'
Paper: 'we use a mask-denoising feature prediction objective ..., where the model predicts masked segments of a video in a learned representation space.'
Paper: 'The outputs of the predictor are then regressed to the prediction targets using an L1 loss.'

Meta blog: 'V-JEPA 2 is a world model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual understanding and prediction in the physical world.' (no use of the word 'generative'; the paper explicitly sets JEPA apart from generative/pixel-level objectives)

quotes.quote: in contrast to approaches based on video generation, the JEPA approach focuses on learning representations for predictable aspects of a scene (e.g., the trajectory of an object in motion) while ignoring unpredictable details that generative objectives emphasize, since they make pixel-level predictions
we use a mask-denoising feature prediction objective ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) , where the model predicts masked segments of a video in a learned representation space.
The outputs of the predictor are then regressed to the prediction targets using an L1 loss.
Meta Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture 2 (V-JEPA 2) is a world model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual understanding and prediction in the physical world.
V-JEPA 2 is intended to represent any video (and image) to perform video classification, retrieval, or as a video encoder for VLMs.

architecture.type: ViT encoder on 2x16x16 tubelets + 12-layer 384-dim predictor (pretraining); EMA target encoder
architecture.representation: frozen encoder output tokens (1408-dim ViT-g, 1280 ViT-H, 1024 ViT-L), pooled downstream by an attentive probe; HF get_vision_features returns the token sequence

pretraining_data.summary: VideoMix22M (22M samples): SSv2 168K, Kinetics-400/600/700 733K, HowTo100M 1.1M, YT-Temporal-1B 19M (retrieval-curated general YouTube), plus ImageNet 1M images (duplicated into 16-frame clips). All named public sources.
pretraining_data.form: dataset list (named; HowTo100M and YT-Temporal-1B are open-ended YouTube-derived sets)
